user.title: Connect to the robot
user.description: Requires root SSH key access and firmware 4.3.5_1612. The private key must already exist inside Home Assistant's filesystem. Verify the robot's SHA256 host-key fingerprint through a trusted connection; changed keys are rejected. Saving is experimental and reboots the robot.

data.key_path: Private key path inside Home Assistant

reconfigure.title: Update robot connection
reconfigure.description: Keep the same robot address. Verify a changed SSH host key through a trusted connection before updating its fingerprint.

data.key_path: Private key path inside Home Assistant

error.cannot_connect: Could not verify the connection. Check the address, key path, trusted fingerprint, root access and firmware 4.3.5_1612.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: Use the configured robot address, or add a new robot.
abort.save_running: Wait for the current save to finish before reconfiguring.
